propositions: Agents and contributors must fast-forward their own worktree after a Gerrit merge completes, not the shared main checkout, to satisfy the close precheck verification that requires the merged commit reachable from HEAD.

The close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists in transition_close.py:32-57) reads git log from the current checkout and validates the rebar-ticket: commit is reachable; this fails when the shared checkout is left at an older commit.

AGENTS.md must document the post-merge fast-forward discipline with explicit guidance: 'git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main' in the worktree, and a warning never to touch the shared main checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must add a new section §2f immediately after §2e (Submit) covering the same post-merge fast-forward and shared-checkout protection guidance.
